content.thinking: The index question is noted, and I'm sticking with the ת"א-125 index: today's amount is 10,000 and the monthly deposit is 500, as set.

The statement lists 70,000 ₪ deposited and a cheapest-option projection of 86,045 ₪ after ten years, about 16,000 more than the deposit. I'm going to skip the other option with the minus figure and the coloured strip, and look into the account and fund names next, including what "מחקה" and "4A" mean.
פסגות מובילה עם עלות של 1,049 ₪ על פני 10 שנים, אבל הבנק שלי היה עולה הרבה יותר. לא ברור לי מה מייצגים הפסים הכתומים והצהובים בגרף, וההערות על חיילים וסטודנטים לא נוגעות אלי כפנסיונר.

The funds at the bottom are more expensive, so I'm skipping them. The first fund, IBI Tel Aviv 125 (5112628), has low fees, but it shows a -0.04% one-year return, and the next one, Tachlit, shows -1,030 ₪, so I'll check one more screen.
The fund figures all show minuses, which may only mean it trailed the index, not that it lost money. The first one had the smallest minus, and I'm stopping here since the screens are tiring you out.

input.answer: According to the page, I'd open the account at פסגות (where it costs only about 1,049 ₪ over ten years, while at לאומי it's 4,506 and at הפועלים 6,530) and buy "אי.בי.אי. מחקה ת"א 125 (4A)", number 5112628, ending with about 86,045 ₪ after fees and tax, "in today's money", against 70,000 ₪ put in. But this is shares, not a deposit, and all those minus signs scared me, so before doing anything I'll go over it with you.

stuck.why: It starts with במדד and English buttons like MSCI and S&P 500. Normally I'd have left right there; I only went on because I came for the ת"א-125 one.
"−0.04%" with "בשנה · שנה אחת". I thought the fund lost money last year and nearly backed away from it.
Every fund has minuses, both percentages and shekels (−1,030, −1,733). Only the small note at the bottom made me think minus means behind the מדד, and I'm not sure I understood it.
I left the 10,000 and 500 that were already filled in. I never checked whether the boxes could be changed or whether I'd need a slider.

findings.what: Minus signs on every fund (−0.04%, −0.37%, −1,030 ₪). They look like losses, and what they mean is only explained in a small note at the very bottom.
The page opens with English letters and the word מדד. For someone looking for safe saving it says 'not for you' straight away.
The same 'לא בחישוב / מחיר אחר לצעירים, לחיילים...' note is on almost every bank, so I had to reread it on each row to find what was different.
The cost bars are orange, yellow and red, and the colour key is somewhere else (screen 3, and again on screen 7). I couldn't match them, and orange and yellow look almost the same to me.
Nothing says whether this is safe like a deposit or how much it could drop. It assumes 7% a year.
Long rows of numbers, one after another. It's a busy screen and it made me anxious.
